long_description: Luma Health is a patient success platform that focuses on scheduling optimization, patient communication, and reducing no-show rates. The platform uses AI-powered automation to handle appointment reminders, waitlist management, and patient outreach. Luma Health integrates with major EHR systems and serves large healthcare organizations seeking to improve patient access and operational efficiency. The company is backed by major healthcare investors and serves health systems across the United States.
